# OrmiTech

> OrmiTech is an AI-powered customer communication platform. It brings Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and website chat into one shared inbox, answers routine customer questions with AI, and hands conversations to a human team when a person is needed.

Website: https://www.ormitechit.com/
Documentation: https://docs.ormitechit.com/

## Product
- [Product overview](https://www.ormitechit.com/product): the full platform
- [AI customer support](https://www.ormitechit.com/product/ai-customer-support): AI replies, drafted responses and handover
- [Omnichannel inbox](https://www.ormitechit.com/product/omnichannel-inbox): all channels in one team inbox
- [Lead and order management](https://www.ormitechit.com/product/lead-order-management): capture leads and orders from chats

## Facts
- Channels: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, website chat
- Core capabilities: shared inbox, AI replies, human handover, automation, lead and order tracking, analytics, team collaboration
- Plans: Free, Starter, Growth, Enterprise (see the pricing page for current details)
